models_data.seo_description: The SafeFUME CAQUAD-A is a high-capacity cyanoacrylate fuming chamber featuring four separate compartments with individual doors, ideal for processing multiple evidence sets simultaneously. With dimensions of 60"W x 27.75"D x 75"H, this quad-configuration chamber maximizes laboratory efficiency while maintaining the security and performance required for forensic fingerprint development.
